new_libraries.name: RcLights
new_libraries.author: Maximilian Bauer <maximilian@bauer.pub>
new_libraries.sentence: Scale light controller for an RC car: three PWM channels in, six PWM light outputs out.
new_libraries.paragraph: Reads steering, throttle and a switch from a receiver and drives park and driving light, tail and brake light, reversing light, two turn signals and an auxiliary output. The turn signals only trigger after the steering has been centred for a moment, so cornering indicates and line corrections do not; the brake and reverse logic follows the ESC you actually have. Channel 3 is a two- or three-position switch whose positions you assign to hazards, an auxiliary output or a light switch. The decision logic is plain C with no Arduino dependency and is covered by host tests; the Arduino layer only measures pulses and writes PWM. Builds for AVR, ESP32 and STM32, and its pin capture works on all three -- on AVR it brings its own pin-change interrupts, because two external interrupt pins are one short of three channels.

library.name: KT_BQ25601
library.author: Kacper Tora
library.sentence: Complete Arduino library for Texas Instruments BQ25601 3A I2C Li-Ion/LiPo charger and OTG boost converter.
library.paragraph: Driver for TI BQ25601 PMIC. Supports configurable fast charge current, termination, input current limits (IINDPM/VINDPM), NVDC power path management, OTG 5V boost mode, watchdog timer, thermistor JEITA monitoring, and full fault diagnostics.

library.name: OpenEmbeddedProbe
library.author: Open Embedded Probe contributors
library.sentence: Open Embedded Probe (OEP): turn an ESP32 / RP2040 / RP2350 board into a debug probe, target console and test fixture that hosts drive through one open protocol.
library.paragraph: Debug wires (RVSWD / SWIO for WCH CH32, SWD), a target console, GPIO / UART fixtures and logic capture, declared by name, under a session lock, over USB vendor bulk, HID, CDC, USB-Serial/JTAG or a UART bridge. The protocol is fixed; capabilities are declared by the probe and anyone can add their own interfaces. Specification: https://github.com/Open-Embedded-Probe/oep-spec
